The '''Sargon system''' was located in the [[Gateworlds]], an area of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It was connected by the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Rynmar Trail]] to the [[Febrini system/Legends|Febrini system]] of the Gateworlds and to the [[Modus system/Legends|Modus system]] in the [[Rifle Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Sargon [[Star system/Legends|system]] was home to the [[Species/Legends|creatures]] known as [[Sargonian behemoth tick]]s.<ref name="SW28" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sargon system was introduced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-9.<ref name="TEA" />
